balls.text: 100 kph slower ball on fifth stump, Kuldeep backs away to cut and misses. They opt to not even attempt a bye.

100 IPL wickets for Mohit! Slower length ball on seventh stump, slogs at this and skies this over backward point. Hardik shuffles to his right from the edge of the circle and takes this reaching forward somewhat awkwardly at knee height before tumbling to the turf and holding on.
short ball on fifth stump, slapped to long-off for one.
slower ball lands full and very wide, goes to heave this and gets an edge that doesn't carry to the keeper.
ankle high full toss on off at 137 kph, punched to long-on for one.
back of a length on middle, goes back to pull and bottom edges this into long-on for one.
full and punched away through the off side for none.
low full toss on middle, Nortje goes for a reverse sweep and misses. Huge lbw shout denied. Looked stone dead. But Hardik curiously opts against a review feeling Nortje must have got glove on it.
good length googly spins in on middle, pushed awkwardly to midwicket for none.
full on the legs, chips this very high toward deep midwicket. Manohar charges in from the rope 20 yards and takes a catch sliding on his knees.
full on fifth stump, driven to long-off for one.
googly lands too short on middle, Aman rocks back and yanks a pull over midwicket landing just short of the first row to bring up a 50-stand off just 26 balls.

full on fifth stump at 137 kph, goes to reverse scoop this over third man but misses off the pads and it dribbles away for none. Hardik goes for DRS purely because there are two overs left in the innings but this has no hope of being given out. It was quite clearly outside off stump by some distance, perhaps would not have even hit two sets of stumps.An all-time shockingly bad review and 60 seconds of our lives we'll never get back. What it does do though is bring into question why he did not use DRS much earlier in the innings on a decision which would have been overturned on Noor's lbw shout.
full and wide on the guideline, heaves this along the ground to long-on for one.
length ball on sixth stump, toe-slapped to long-on for one.
full and wide, driven square of the sweeper to bring up a maiden IPL fifty off 41 balls for Aman.
slower ball lands full on middle, skies a flick high and deep over square leg sailing well past the LCD ad boards but just short of the grandstand.

slower ball lands on a good length wide outside off on the guideline, slapped to the cover sweeper for one but the relay is wild and escapes Mohit wide of the non-striker's stumps so they take a second on an overthrow.
fullish length on off, punches this firmly down the ground and beats long-off to the rope.
good length ball on middle, flicked through to deep midwicket for two.
full on fourth stump, punched past Little to long-on for one.
length ball on sixth stump at 140 kph, slaps this on the up and barely clears mid-off before going to the rope.
back of a length on middle, shuffles across to flick through square leg for one.
full and wide, drives hard at this and a thick edge skids along the ground past short third and goes to the rope.
back of a length on off, goes back to flick through midwicket for a single.
good length ball on sixth stump, goes to swat this again and bottom edges it into the ground for one before dribbling away.
133 kph bouncer lands on middle stump and sits up to be hooked over fine leg sailing flat over the rope thudding into the base of the LCD ad boards. Only 59 meters, but enough.
107 kph slower ball on a good length on fourth stump, defended to extra cover for none.
length ball on seventh stump, goes to punch this 136 kph delivery and gets a thick toe edge that gets past short third on the edge of the circle before going to the rope.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back to flick through backward square leg for one.
good length ball on sixth stump, poked behind point for one.
floats this way outside leg stump, Saha does well shuffling across to stop it from being five.
good length ball slanted across seventh stump, opens the face trying to run this to deep third for one but misses.
full and wide, driven to the cover sweeper for one.
full and wide on seventh stump, slices a drive high over extra cover for two.
full on the stumps, misses a flick off the pads again.
full outside leg, goes to flick and comes off the pads to short fine leg for none.

full on off stump at 129 kph, Axar drives to shovel this back over the bowler out of the ground but gets under it too much and skies it high in front of the sightscreen. Rashid scampers over 20 yards to his left before settling on his knees five yards inside the rope to take this catch.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended to mid-off.
good length ball flicked away for a sharp two. 50 stand comes up off 54 balls. Good for an ODI, not so much for a T20.
full on sixth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, punched to long-off for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched wide of mid-off for one.
full on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball outside leg hits him on the outside of the leg stump padding, no shout for lbw.
full on fifth stump, punched to extra cover for none.
short and wide, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
overpitched outside off, driven through extra cover and beats long-off to the rope.
full on off, jammed out to long-on for one.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.
full on sixth stump, punched to mid-off for none.
good length ball on middle, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
googly spins off the pads down the leg side past a flick for a leg bye.
good length ball on the stumps, defended.
googly spins in from fourth stump and hits Aman on middle stump defending down the wrong line, big lbw shout denied. Hardik can't be coaxed into using DRS.
full outside leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on sixth stump, slapped through the legs of extra cover to wide long-off for two.
googly spins across Aman after landing on a fullish length on off stump, beaten poking forward.
full and well outside leg, goes to sweep and misses off the pads.
full outside leg stump spinning toward off, prods forward and misses off the pads, lbw shout denied.
full on sixth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
good length ball on the stumps, punched down the ground for one.

dropped! Full on middle, chips this in the air over Rashid tailing toward Miller running along the rope coming across from long-off. He reaches up above his head to his left in stride with a slight bunny hop and it slips through his hands before going over the rope. 9/10 on difficulty, but Miller has taken far more difficult ones.
good length ball down the leg side, wide called.
googly on fifth stump spinning in, flicked to long-on for one.
full on sixth stump, goes to drive and is beaten.
good length on middle, goes back to punch to long-off for one.
back of a length on off, goes back to punch to extra cover for none.
full on seventh stump, gets on a knee and slogs this to wide long-on for one.
low full toss floated just inside the wide guideline and left alone wanting a wide called but none happens.
back of a length skidding into the pads, goes back to flick and misses off the body.
back of a length on middle, defended to Noor.
short and down leg past an attempted short arm jab pull, wide called.
full on the legs, flicked behind square leg for one.
short on fifth stump, goes to pull and bottom edges this into square leg for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended on the front foot back to Rashid.
short on fifth stump, Aman picks the length early and rocks back to short arm shovel this high over long-on into the second row.
fullish length ball on fifth stump, pokes this to extra cover for none.
googly spins across a good length from middle stump, punched into cover for a tight single.
good length ball is a legbreak skidding on from middle stump, defended on the back foot.
good length googly spins from fourth stump to middle, prod forward produces an inside edge past forward short leg for one.
good length ball on fourth stump at 140 kph, punched on the up to mid-off for none.
good length on off, punched to mid-off for none.
fullish length ball angled in on sixth stump, punched on the up with a high elbow and it flies through the gap between mid-off and extra cover to the rope.
back of a length ball on fourth stump at 140 kph, punched awkwardly past the non-striker to mid-off for none.
141 kph good length ball on off, defended to mid-off for none.
full on fifth stump, defended.
full on fifth stump at 144 kph, pumps a drive along the turf through mid-off to the rope.
back of a length on off stump, defended to cover.
back of a length on leg stump at 137 kph, backs away before defending to cover.
fullish length ball on sixth stump, drives hard at this and is beaten.
back of a length on the stumps, defended.
fullish length ball on the stumps, pushed into the ring for one.

just let Shami bowl four straight with the new ball! Fullish length ball in the sixth stump channel, no away swing this time. Not really a drivable length but Garg pushes at this with little footwork anyway and a thick edge carries comfortably to Saha at chest height for a far less entertaining catch than he had at the start of the over.
full on the legs at 138 kph, late on a flick and it comes off the pads and an inside edge dribbling through midwicket for one.
good length ball on seventh stump at 138 kph, left alone again.
fullish length ball on middle, punched to mid-off for none.
good length ball on fifth stump angled across Axar, left alone.

Shami can do no wrong, especially when he gets a tremendous flying catch from behind the stumps by Saha! Full length swinging away a touch on fourth stump, there to drive but Pandey is a touch late with no footwork and the late movement finds the edge to produce a chance flying low to Saha's right at knee height. He dives across first slip and snags a one-handed stunner while completing the sideways tumble on his hips to ensure his elbows don't hit the ground to jar the ball loose.
back of a length on fifth stump, guided with an open face behind point and Mohit at deep third puts in a tremendous diving stop to keep this to two.
143 kph delivery back of a length on middle, pulled off the front foot to deep fine leg for one.
141 kph ball lands short of a length on fourth stump, cross bats this short of mid-on for a single.
good length ball defended.
full and wide on eighth stump, stabs at this with open wrists to guide it along the turf to deep third for one.
back of a length on middle at 128 kph, miscues a pull that falls short of the fielder on the ring by a few yards.
back of a length on fifth stump at 140 kph, punched to cover for none.

this is beautiful bowling in any format! Good length ball at 132 kph angled across middle and off stump from over the wicket on a perfect channel that teases Rossouw into poking at this defensively but there's enough sideways movement to clip the outside edge and carry through comfortably to Saha at thigh height.
back of a length on the legs, goes to flick and misses off the pads going into cover for none.
fullish length on fifth stump, punches this to mid-off for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, goes to punch through cover and misses as the ball seams in.
back of a length swinging away toward the wide guideline, goes to cut and misses.
short on the hips, goes back to flick a short arm jab pull behind square leg to the rope.
back of a length on sixth stump, slapped on the up through the gap between mid-off and extra cover to the rope.
good length ball defended to mid-off for none.
good length ball on off, tapped into the covers defensively.
full and angled into the legs, flicks this to deep fine leg for one.

kamikaze runout!  Good length ball on the stumps flicked to short midwicket where Rashid Khan collects. Warner sets off from the non-striker's end but Garg goes nowhere. Rashid alertly runs straight to the non-striker's stumps rather than risking a throw because he knows he'll beat Warner in a footrace from 12 yards if the Delhi captain tries to stop and turn around mid pitch. Rashid gets to the stumps and just flicks the bails off himself with Warner having given up. Siren signals a no ball overstep so a free hit will happen next ball.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended.
good length ball on the hips at 134 kph, defended back to Shami.
full on the legs at 144 kph, flicked through square leg for two.
full on sixth stump swinging away at 139 kph, driven along the turf through the covers and chased down by Rashid at the rope to keep this to three.
back of a length on seventh stump at 140 kph, goes for a flat-footed poke with open wrists trying to guide a single to deep third but misses.
full on fourth stump, punched to extra cover again, this time along the ground.

half-volley drilled to extra cover first ball! Shami sent this down at a juicy tempting width on sixth stump and Salt lashed this flat to Miller at rib height. Didn't have to move standing eight yards in from the ring.

142 kph knee high full toss on the wide guideline, Rashid tries to muscle this over the leg side but flubs this slicing it high over backward point for just a single. Last place Delhi have clawed back in the most extraordinary way to knock off the league-leaders and defending IPL champs by five runs.

dropped! Low and wide, Rashid slams this with immense timing and power to Rossouw at cover on the ring who flies to his right and makes a driving stop to knock this down and turns four into two. Technically a dropped chance too at knee height which would have officially sealed the match. But they take two runs. A six will force a super over...

119 kph slower length ball on fifth stump, Tewatia tries to muscle this over the leg side again but miscues it off the splice fluttering gently to Rossouw five yards inside the ring at extra cover and he backpedals a few steps for a simple head high catch.

full and wide yorker just inside the guidelines, Tewatia clears the front leg and misses a wild heave to this 143 kph delivery. Tewatia goes to DRS claiming this should be a wide for a bonus run and ball, but he's going to lose this. It was comfortably inside the wide guideline. Review lost.
full and wide, sliced behind point for a casual one to put Tewatia on strike.

ankle high full toss on eighth stump, miscues a slice high toward Nortje running in from cover sweeper. If it was a World Cup Final, he'd have put in a dive for a catch that would also have been a dot ball but instead he lets it land at his feet and two runs are taken.

hat-trick of sixes for Tewatia over the leg side rope! Off Nortje too!  Knee high full toss on fourth stump as Nortje finally corrects his line wider, but Tewatia was anticipating the line being dragged that far and shuffles way outside off for the first time to get in line before smoking this with a pull high and deep over wide long-on for an 88-meter strike.
Tewatia magic! Full in the slot on leg stump at 148 kph, Tewatia stays stationary in the crease and clears the front leg to slaughter this high over wide midwicket landing 20 meters beyond the rope.
knee high full toss on the legs at 148 kph, Tewatia smokes a six pulling this flat over the deep square leg fielder.
yorker follows Hardik backing away from leg stump and he digs this out to long-on for one.
144 kph full on leg stump, whipped out to deep midwicket for a frantic two.
142 kph yorker on off, jammed out to Nortje.
knee high full toss on the wide guideline again at 139 kph, just another firm punch that backs out backward point for a diving stop to keep it to one.
125 kph slower short ball on middle, Tewatia plays a short-arm paddle pull to deep square leg for one.

140 kph thigh high full toss on the wide guideline, Hardik tries to place this with a firm punch wide of the cover sweeper but picks him out for only a single. Should have been a free boundary but Hardik can't capitalize on it.
yorker on off at 139 kph, jammed out back to the bowler for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, pushed gently past the ring fielder chasing after it and Hardik wanted two after jogging for most of the first run but Tewatia wisely says no.

Manohar's struggle comes to an end. Length ball on off stump at 139 kph, yet another attempted pull is miscued but this one finally has enough pace on it off the bat to reach a boundary fielder. Aman jogs in 10 yards off the rope at long-on for a basic chest high catch.
another quicker ball lands short on the legs, flicked in the air short of Warner charging in from long-on for one.
117 kph quicker ball yanked short on the legs, pulled to deep midwicket along the ground for one.
short again on middle and leg, this time Manohar connects with a pull to deep midwicket for one.
short outside leg, the ball sticks in the wicket a bit and Manohar is way out in front of a pull that hits him in the ribs.
full on leg stump, flicked to wide long-on for a single to bring up a 44-ball half-century. Just a gentle hand wave from Hardik to acknowledge the milestone, no bat raise. The job is not done.
good length on off, Manohar sits back to swat this over wide mid-on for one.

ful on fifth stump, punched firmly to mid-off for a tight single but a rushed and unnecessary overthrow at the non-striker's stumps is wide (and they wouldn't have come close to getting Hardik out anyway) to allow for a second on an overthrow.
back of a length on middle, punched to long-on for one.
full on middle, driven to long-on for one.
back of a length on middle, defended.
short on middle, laces a pull firmly through square leg and finds the rope. The blue flags are waving fiercely in the crowd.
good length ball on fifth stump, prodded into the covers for one.
good length ball tailing down the leg side, wide called.
fullish length ball on seventh stump, slaps this to Rossouw at cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on off, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
short on off, Manohar miscues a pull that dribbles well short of long-on for one.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked away for one.

short on sixth stump, slices a cut in front of backward point but it is backspinning away sharply from Rossouw racing to his left along the rope from sweeper. He dives to try to keep this in play but it comes off his hands and continues to the rope anyway.
good length ball on fifth stump, punched to cover for none.
good length ball on sixth stump, punched just wide of the diving effort at extra cover to long-off for one.
short on the body, shuffles across and tucks a short arm jab pull well behind deep square leg to find the rope.
137 kph delivery lands full on seventh stump, driven along the ground to long-off for one.
length ball on sixth stump seams away after being angled in and beats the drive.
back of a length on fifth stump at 136 kph, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
fullish length outside off, sliced to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on off, punched straight to extra cover for one.
full on sixth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
good length on the hips, flicked behind square leg for one.
Axar slides this in quicker on a good length on middle, defended back to Axar.
good length ball on middle, goes back to flick to long-on for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, Hardik leans back to cut to the sweeper for one.
short and wide, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
full on off, punched to extra cover for none.
good length on middle, shuffles far across to flick through midwicket for one.
full on fourth stump, punched to long-off for one.
back of a length on middle and leg, punched back to Kuldeep for none.
good length ball on the wide guideline, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
134 kph length ball on seventh stump, stroked on the up at a catchable height but well in front of backward point going to the cover sweeper for one.
short on fourth stump, goes to pull and is through the shot too early and hit on the back shoulder with a big thud.
short on fifth stump at 140 kph, miscues a pull that falls well short of deep midwicket for one.
slower ball yorker sprayed down the leg side and Salt fumbles this diving to his left to turn it into two wides with Hardik coming back on strike.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched behind point to the sweeper for one.
138 kph landing full on fifth stump, punched to mid-off for none.
good length ball on the stumps, punched down the ground to long-on for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to backward point for none.
good length ball on off, tapped to backward point for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched wide of the cover sweeper for two.
good length ball on sixth stump, prodded in front of cover for one.
good length ball sliding down leg past a flick, wide called.
back of a length on sixth stump, tapped to backward point for none.
short on the legs, Manohar picks the length early and carts a pull high over backward square leg landing 79 meters away.
full and wide, tapped in the gap between cover and extra cover for one.
full outside leg stump, goes to sweep and misses as the ball spins off the glove ricocheting into the helmet.
full on fifth stump, prodded in front of backward point for one.
full on sixth stump, driven to long-off for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to backward point.
full on fourth stump, driven to long-off for one.
full on middle, whipped straight to midwicket for none.
back of a length on middle, punched back to Axar fielding in front of the non-striker.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to extra cover.
good length ball on fourth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
full on fourth stump, punched to long-off for one.
good length ball slanted in on fourth stump, defended to Axar.
short on the stumps, pulled straight to short fine leg for none.
good length ball on middle, defended to midwicket.

bullseye! Bowled behind the legs after an audacious shuffle across! Miller tries to play a release shot walking all the way across his stumps to scoop over fine leg and the early dot ball pressure results in a third-ball duck as middle and off stump are pinged back.
full on middle and leg, defended to cover.
full on off, punched past the non-striker to long-off for one.
full on fifth stump, Hardik pushes at this and is beaten.
back of a length on leg stump at 142 kph, defended to point for none.
back of a length on middle, flicked into square leg for one.
back of a length on off stump, defended into the covers for none.
short on the body at 142 kph, shuffles inside the line and pulls this flat along the ground between the keeper and short fine leg to the rope.
back of a length on middle and leg at 146 kph, defended to midwicket for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to the off side.

bullseye! 119 kph slower ball foxes Shankar flicking across the line too early. It's a knuckle ball that would make Tim Wakefield and Charlie Hough proud landing very full on off stump line before cannoning into middle and off halfway up.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to the off side for none.
full on middle, driven firmly but straight to mid-on for none.

139 kph good length ball on middle and off, flicks this with supreme timing through wide midwicket, Nortje gives a clumsy feet first slide along the rope trying to save this but it eludes him to the rope.
good length ball angled in toward off stump at 139 kph, defended off an inside edge flicking the pads toward backward point for one.
fullish length ball at 137 kph, punched to mid-off for none.
150 kph delivery lands back of a length on the hips, flicked through midwicket for two.
back of a length on off at 143 kph, flicked to midwicket for none.
back of a length on off at 145 kph, defended off the back foot to mid-on.
back of a length tailing down the leg side at 151 kph, left alone and wide called.
back of a length on off, flicked into the leg side for none.
back of a length on off at 148 kph, defended.

half-volley sliced straight to cover! Nortje channels the first ball wicket to start the match by Shami to Salt! This was sent down on seventh stump and Gill opens the face to drive this toward point but it is spliced low to cover at knee height and the catch is taken lunging forward.
back of a length on sixth stump angled in before seaming away and sucks Hardik into poking at this before he is beaten.
short and wide on eighth stump at 137 kph, slices a cut high over backward point in swashbuckling style and it bounces just short of the rope before thudding into the foam triangle.
short on fifth stump at 140 kph, pulled off the front foot with disdain through wide mid-on to the rope.
134 kph good length ball on middle and leg, defended to mid-off for none.
full on the legs at 139 kph, flicked to the deep square leg boundary.
good length ball on fourth stump at 137 kph, punched to mid-off for none.
back of a length on seventh stump, cuts this firmly in front of point to the boundary.
slower ball full toss at waist height on middle, swatted through square leg for two.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended.
good length ball on off, defended.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to extra cover.
good length ball on eighth stump, left alone.

fullish length angled across seventh stump at 136 kph and continues seaming away, Saha pokes at this flat-footed yet again and finally pays the price. Thin edge flies low at knee height to Salt taking this diving in front of first slip.
good length ball on sixth stump at 132 kph, left alone.
full on fifth stump at 139 kph, punched straight to extra cover.
full and angled across eighth stump, pokes at this flat-footed and is beaten.
good length ball angled wider on fifth stump, pokes at this and is beaten.
gem! Good length ball at 138 kph swings in late and beats Saha's outside edge flicking across the line on fourth stump.
